name: blender
description: Inspect, navigate, render, and automate Blender through the official Blender Lab MCP server.

shortDescription.en-US: Inspect and control Blender through its official MCP server.
shortDescription.zh-CN: 通过 Blender 官方 MCP 检查和控制场景。

longDescription.en-US: Use Blender Lab's official MCP server to inspect scenes, search bundled Blender documentation, capture the interface, navigate workspaces, render images, and execute approved Python code inside Blender.
longDescription.zh-CN: 使用 Blender Lab 官方 MCP 检查场景、搜索内置 Blender 文档、截取界面、切换工作区、渲染图像，并在批准后于 Blender 内执行 Python 代码。

defaultPrompt: 总结当前 Blender 场景的对象、集合和渲染设置
在 Blender Python API 文档中查找我需要的接口
检查当前场景并在修改前给出操作计划

mcpServers.name: Blender MCP
mcpServers.description: Official Blender Lab MCP server pinned to the reviewed v1.0.0 MCP Bundle.
permissions: Requires Blender 5.1 or newer with the official Blender MCP extension enabled
Starts a local Python MCP process through uv and may download Python plus locked dependencies on first launch
Connects only to the configured Blender extension port on localhost
Can inspect the active scene, object hierarchy, local blend-file metadata, missing file paths, and Blender window state
Approved command-line tools can open an explicitly supplied local .blend file in a background Blender process and may create then remove a temporary synchronized copy beside that file
Can capture Blender screenshots, navigate workspaces and viewports, and write render output to user-selected paths
Approved arbitrary Python runs inside Blender with the same local files, network, and process privileges as Blender

configFields.label: uv executable path
configFields.description: Use uv from PATH or enter its absolute executable path if the Anybox desktop process cannot find it.

configFields.label: Blender MCP port
configFields.description: Must match the port configured in the Blender MCP extension. The host is intentionally fixed to localhost.

configFields.label: Blender executable path
configFields.description: Optional executable path used only by approved *_for_cli tools. Leave empty to resolve the blender command from PATH.

installReview: Install uv before first use. If the desktop app cannot find uv on PATH, configure its absolute executable path.
The first launch may download a compatible Python runtime and dependencies exactly described by the bundled uv.lock file.
Install and enable the official Blender MCP extension separately in Blender 5.1 or newer, then keep its host on localhost and make its port match this plugin.
Only reviewed documentation and scene-inspection tools are auto-allowed. Screenshots, navigation, rendering, and other unspecified tools require approval by default.

The *_for_cli tools require an explicit local blend-file path, can launch background Blender, and may create then remove a temporary synchronized copy beside a dirty open file; they require approval by default.
execute_blender_code requires approval but can still read, modify, delete, or transmit any data available to the Blender process; approval is not an operating-system sandbox.
